one of the most beautiful mausoleums on the outskirts of hue emperor city Tu Duc was the fourth emperor of the Nguyen dynasty and he was on the throne over 35 years the longest one compared to other rulers having no sanctuary he ordered the construction of his tomb to create a fairy land not only was it a world for his everlasting life after death but it was also his lifetime recreation ground where he could meditate write poetry and hunt animals the tomb was built between 1864 and 1867 and is about six kilometers southwest from hue city center unlike the architecture of other tombs in hue tomb of consists of two main parts arranged on two parallel vertical axes here there are always the sounds of the flowing stream wrestling pine hills and singing birds the ticket is 100 000 Vietnam Thien Mu pagoda right now is one of the most beautiful pagodas in vietnam and what i love the most about this place is that it's located near the perfume lake look at that beautiful view behind me according to legend an old woman once appeared on the hill and said that the lord would build a buddhist pagoda for the country's prosperity lord nguyen hoang heard the message and he ordered the construction of the pagoda and named it heavenly lady which means Thien Mu in vietnamese this sacred place houses the car that monk Thich Quang Duc used before burning himself to death in the protest against the region's violations of religious freedom the pagoda was heavily damaged in 1943 but was then fully renovated for over 30 years thereafter the best time to visit Thien Mu pagoda is early morning or in the afternoon when the sun goes down is free entrance and you can take a boat trip upstream perfume river however during flood time from the end of october to mid-november yearly you shouldn't travel by boat for your own safety last but not least the iconic symbol of hue is the imperial city which was recognized as a unesco world heritage site in 1993. i literally feel like a princess walking in my own palace right now it is so beautiful a major military campaign during the american vietnam war in 1968 called the Tet offensive caused serious damage to the hue imperial city of the 160 buildings only 10 major structures remained after the battle the architectural style is basically modeled after the forbidden city in beijing the whole complex was massive with sophisticated architecture that impresses every tourist so i definitely suggest you guys to come here after four because because the weather is so much cooler the ticket is 150 000 vietnam dome per
